Proposition 4.4 claimed that the direct rotation wins in every unitarily invariant norm, and this pair shows that it does not.
Davis and Kahan prove that the direct rotation minimizes the squared displacement, the identity minus W, star, times the identity minus W, in every unitarily invariant norm.
Davis and Kahan write the Ky Fan norms with a subscript, so their subscript one is the Ky Fan one-norm, the largest singular value, which is the operator norm.
